The Eurostat comparison and legal reporting distinction affirmatively identify a different target measure rather than merely missing evidence. The narrow error reverses the numerical premise of a substantial draft-reassessment argument.

Preserve this affirmative source rescue prominently. It explains the error and precludes alleging invented data, but cannot reconcile the explicit69percent compliance-basis claim with Eurostat’s legal reporting series.
